description: This file contains the implementation of the Registry class within the Opencart System Engine namespace. It provides a registry pattern to store, retrieve, and manage objects in a centralized manner, with methods for dynamic property access (__get, __set, __isset) and manipulation of stored data.

classes.name: Registry
classes.description: A class implementing the registry pattern to manage shared objects within the system. It provides methods to dynamically add, retrieve, check, and remove objects by key, facilitating object management and dependency injection.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to retrieve an object by key, invoking the get() method internally.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Magic method to assign an object to a key, invoking the set() method internally.

methods.name: __isset
methods.description: Magic method to check whether a key exists in the registry, invoking the has() method internally.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an object stored under the specified key, returning null if not found.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores an object in the registry under the specified key.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if an object exists in the registry under the given key.

methods.name: unset
methods.description: Removes the object associated with the specified key from the registry.
